hints.title: Prefix Rate Accumulation
hints.text: Notice that merged segments accumulate consecutive travel times into effective segment speeds.

hints.title: State Formulation
hints.text: Track the current station index, the remaining number of merge skips, and the starting index of the active speed window.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: At each station, branch on the next stop choice while deducting skipped intermediate stations from the quota.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Prefix sums provide instant O(1) query of speed sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all combinations of k merges leads to exponential search spaces.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization records station positions and skip counts to prevent overlapping recomputation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the optimal substructure and formulate the three-dimensional state space.
